description: This file defines the Adapters class and related inner classes, providing functionality to load and manage XML-defined adapters, particularly cursor adapters, in Android applications. It includes mechanisms for data binding, data transformations, and loader management for cursor data from content providers.

classes.name: Adapters
classes.description: Main class providing static methods to load and manage adapters defined via XML, including inner classes for cursor binding and transformation logic.

classes.name: Adapters.CursorBinder
classes.description: Abstract class defining the interface for binding cursor data to views.

classes.name: Adapters.CursorTransformation
classes.description: Abstract class defining transformation operations on cursor data before binding.

classes.name: Adapters.XmlCursorAdapter
classes.description: Implementation of a cursor adapter loaded from XML, wrapping around SimpleCursorAdapter and managing data loading.

classes.name: Adapters.IdentityTransformation
classes.description: Default transformation that returns cursor column data as-is.

classes.name: Adapters.ExpressionTransformation
classes.description: Transforms cursor data into a formatted string based on an expression template with column placeholders.

classes.name: Adapters.MapTransformation
classes.description: Allows mapping specific string or resource values to different output representations.

classes.name: Adapters.StringBinder
classes.description: Concrete CursorBinder binding string data to TextView.

classes.name: Adapters.ImageBinder
classes.description: Concrete CursorBinder binding image blob data to ImageView.

classes.name: Adapters.TagBinder
classes.description: Concrete CursorBinder binding cursor data as a tag to View.

classes.name: Adapters.ImageUriBinder
classes.description: Concrete CursorBinder binding URI string from cursor to ImageView.

classes.name: Adapters.DrawableBinder
classes.description: Concrete CursorBinder binding drawable resource ID from cursor to ImageView.

methods.name: loadCursorAdapter
methods.description: Loads a CursorAdapter from XML resource, configuring it with URI or existing cursor.

methods.name: loadAdapter
methods.description: General method to load various types of adapters from XML, handling type determination and instantiation.

methods.name: createAdapterFromXml
methods.description: Creates appropriate adapter instance based on XML root tag.

methods.name: createCursorAdapter
methods.description: Creates an XmlCursorAdapter instance from XML parser.
